goal.en: Say exactly what you mean: the right collocation, the right shade of meaning, the right amount of certainty.
goal.ar: أن تقول ما تعنيه بالضبط: التلازم اللفظي الصحيح، والدرجة الدقيقة للمعنى، والقدر المناسب من اليقين.

review.title: From an academic book review
review.text: Whatever its merits — and there are several — this study rests on a narrow evidence base. The author draws heavily on interviews conducted in a single institution, yet the conclusions are framed as though they applied to the sector as a whole. This is not to say the argument is without value; the chapter on informal networks is genuinely illuminating. It is simply that the claims outrun the data, and a more cautious framing would have served the book better.

text.en: At C1, grammar is rarely the problem — word partnership is. English says “heavy rain”, not “strong rain”; “make a decision”, not “do a decision”. Collocation is what separates correct English from natural English.
text.ar: في هذا المستوى نادراً ما تكون المشكلة نحوية، بل في اقتران الكلمات. تقول الإنجليزية heavy rain لا strong rain، وmake a decision لا do a decision. والتلازم اللفظي هو الفارق بين اللغة الصحيحة واللغة الطبيعية.

text.en: Record vocabulary in pairs, never alone: not “decision” but “make a difficult decision”.
text.ar: دوّن المفردات في سياق زوجي لا مفردة: لا تكتب decision وحدها بل make a difficult decision.

head: Word
Shade of meaning
rows: understand something you did not grasp before
state something that may not be true
accept something that weakens your own case

text.en: Choosing “claim” instead of “say” tells the reader you doubt the statement. At C1, word choice carries an attitude.
text.ar: اختيارك claim بدل say يخبر القارئ أنك تشكك في الكلام. في هذا المستوى تحمل الكلمة موقفاً لا معنى فقط.

text.en: Academic and professional English rarely says “this proves”. It says “this suggests”, “it appears that”, “the data indicate”. Overclaiming damages your credibility more than caution does.
text.ar: نادراً ما تقول الإنجليزية الأكاديمية «هذا يثبت»، بل تقول «يشير إلى» و«يبدو أن» و«تدل البيانات». والمبالغة في الجزم تضر بمصداقيتك أكثر مما يضر التحفّظ.

items.en: The results suggest a link between the two factors.
items.ar: تشير النتائج إلى وجود صلة بين العاملين.

items.en: This may partly explain the delay.
items.ar: قد يفسّر هذا جزئياً سبب التأخير.

items.en: It would be premature to conclude that…
items.ar: من السابق لأوانه أن نستنتج أن…

text.en: Advanced writers criticise politely. “A more cautious framing would have served the book better” is a negative judgement dressed as a suggestion. Learn to hear the judgement.
text.ar: الكتّاب المتقدمون ينتقدون بلطف. فجملة «كان الإطار الأكثر تحفّظاً ليخدم الكتاب أفضل» حكم سلبي في ثوب اقتراح. تدرّب على سماع الحكم خلف العبارة.

text.en: Watch for “yet”, “although”, “it is simply that”, “whatever its merits” — these signal that a criticism is coming.
text.ar: انتبه لعبارات مثل yet وalthough وit is simply that وwhatever its merits، فهي إشارات إلى نقد قادم.

questions.sentence: We need to ___ a decision before Friday.

explanation.en: English “makes” decisions. (French and Arabic both prefer “take”, which is why “take a decision” slips out — though it does exist in some formal British usage.)
explanation.ar: الإنجليزية تقول make a decision. والعربية تقول «يتخذ قراراً» فيقع الخلط، ورغم وجود take a decision في بعض الاستعمال البريطاني الرسمي، فإن make هي الأشيع والأسلم.

questions.sentence: She has ___ extensive research into urban migration.

explanation.en: Research is conducted or carried out (or simply “done”), never “made”.
explanation.ar: البحث يُجرى: conducted أو carried out أو done، ولا نقول made research.

explanation.en: “Heavy” collocates with smoker, drinker, traffic, rain. There is no logic to memorise — only usage.
explanation.ar: كلمة heavy تلازم smoker وdrinker وtraffic وrain. لا منطق وراء ذلك، بل استعمال يُحفظ.

prompt.en: Match each verb with the noun it partners.
prompt.ar: صِل كل فعل بالاسم الذي يلازمه.

explanation.en: These verb + noun pairs are fixed in formal English.
explanation.ar: هذه الأزواج ثابتة في الإنجليزية الرسمية.

prompt.en: “The minister claimed that costs had fallen.” What does “claimed” add?
prompt.ar: ماذا تضيف كلمة claimed في هذه الجملة؟

options: Doubt about whether it is true.
That he said it in writing.

explanation.en: “Claim” signals that the writer is not endorsing the statement — a small word with a large effect.
explanation.ar: كلمة claim تشير إلى أن الكاتب لا يتبنى الكلام. كلمة صغيرة بأثر كبير.

prompt.en: Which verb suggests the speaker accepts something that weakens their own position?
prompt.ar: أي فعل يدل على أن المتكلم يعترف بما يُضعف موقفه؟

explanation.en: “Admit” concedes a point against yourself; “argue” defends one; “note/observe” are neutral.
explanation.ar: admit اعتراف بما يضر بموقفك، وargue دفاع عن موقف، وnote وobserve محايدتان.

questions.sentence: The committee ___ the proposal after a long discussion, but no vote was held.

explanation.en: “No vote was held” rules out approval, rejection and implementation; only “considered” fits.
explanation.ar: عبارة «لم يُجرَ تصويت» تستبعد الموافقة والرفض والتنفيذ، فلا يبقى إلا considered بمعنى «نظرت في».

prompt.en: Which sentence is most appropriate in an academic paper?

options: These findings suggest that early intervention may reduce dropout rates.
These findings prove that early intervention stops students dropping out.
Early intervention definitely fixes the dropout problem.

explanation.en: “Suggest” + “may” calibrates the claim to the evidence. Absolute language invites easy refutation.
explanation.ar: suggest مع may تُعاير الادعاء بحجم الدليل، أما اللغة القاطعة فتُسهّل دحضها.

prompt.en: You disagree with a colleague's plan in a meeting. Which is most professional?
prompt.ar: تختلف مع خطة زميلك في اجتماع. ما الأكثر مهنية؟

options: I wonder whether that timeline is realistic given the resources we have.
That timeline is impossible and everyone in this room knows it.
You clearly haven't thought this through before bringing it to us.
I don't agree at all with this, and I think we should drop it.

explanation.en: Hedged disagreement attacks the plan, not the person, and leaves room for the other side to move.
explanation.ar: الاعتراض المتحفّظ يوجّه النقد إلى الخطة لا إلى الشخص، ويترك مجالاً للتراجع دون إحراج.

prompt.en: What is the reviewer's overall judgement?

options: The book is worth reading but overstates its case.
The book proves its argument convincingly.
The book is only about informal networks.

explanation.en: “There are several merits” and “genuinely illuminating” give credit; “the claims outrun the data” is the core criticism.
explanation.ar: الإشادة واضحة في «هناك عدة مزايا» و«مضيء حقاً»، والنقد الجوهري في «الادعاءات تتجاوز البيانات».

prompt.en: “A more cautious framing would have served the book better.” This is:

options: a neutral description of the method

explanation.en: The third conditional implies the book did not do this — a criticism softened by form, not weakened in substance.
explanation.ar: صيغة الشرط الثالث تفيد أن الكتاب لم يفعل ذلك، فهو نقد لُطِّف شكله دون أن يضعف مضمونه.

prompt.en: What does “This is not to say the argument is without value” do?
prompt.ar: ما وظيفة عبارة This is not to say the argument is without value؟

options: It prevents the criticism from being read as total rejection.
It introduces a new topic for the following paragraph.
It withdraws the earlier criticism completely and finally.
It states the author's own view rather than the reviewer's.

explanation.en: It is a concession move: it limits the scope of the criticism while keeping it intact.
explanation.ar: هي حركة تنازل بلاغية تحدّ من مدى النقد دون أن تلغيه.

prompt.en: Which sentence contains an unnatural collocation?
prompt.ar: أي جملة فيها اقتران غير طبيعي؟

options: The study makes a strong contribution to the field.
The study does a strong contribution to the field.
The study draws on extensive fieldwork.

explanation.ar: نقول make a contribution ولا نقول do a contribution.

prompt.en: Soften this claim in one word: “This proves that the policy failed.” → “This ___ that the policy failed.”
prompt.ar: خفّف حدّة هذا الادعاء بكلمة واحدة: This ___ that the policy failed.

explanation.en: “Suggests / indicates / implies” all reduce the strength of the claim to fit the evidence.
explanation.ar: كلمات suggests وindicates وimplies تخفّض درجة الجزم لتناسب حجم الدليل.

prompt.en: Which sentence is the most precise?

options: Participation fell sharply after the fee was introduced.
Participation went down a lot after the fee was introduced.
Participation became less after the fee was introduced.
Participation was decreasing much after the fee came.

explanation.en: “Fell sharply” is the standard collocation for a steep decline; the others are vague or unnatural.
explanation.ar: fell sharply هو التعبير المعتاد عن انخفاض حاد، وبقية الصيغ إما مبهمة أو غير طبيعية.
